notes: What the site reads a post body as. `shared/reading-time.ts` strips the markdown a card shows as plain text and derives the card's label (`postExcerpt`); the app draws the same card, so `PostText.kt` is pinned to these strings by `shared/fixtures/__tests__/post-text.test.ts` and the app's `PostTextFixtureTest` (ADR-0098). `fallback` is what the card shows when the body has no text of its own, and `excerpt` is the label the card and its share text carry.
